name: Call of the Darkwing's Shadow Bat hits with its owner's level of weapon damage (#9158)
contract: Shadow Bat 50069 (summoned by Call of the Darkwing 801958/802578, SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON, SummonProperties 61
= ally guardian, type=12 CREATURE_TYPE_NON_COMBAT_PET, pinned 1/1 creature_template level band) relied on
Guardian::InitStatsForLevel re-deriving its stats from the owner, but that function only re-derives weapon
damage for a hardcoded stock-pet entry list; entry 50069 matched none of them, so the bat kept its level-1
white hit (the flat ~3 damage of #9158) regardless of the owner's actual level.
bloodmage_darkwing_bat mirrors ranger_wingman_companions: it re-derives base weapon damage and attack
power from creature_classlevelstats at the guardian's level in OnPlayerAfterGuardianInitStatsForLevel,
which runs after Guardian::InitStats has already raised the guardian to the owner's level.
Expected: a level-80 Bloodmage's Shadow Bat reports level-80 minimum weapon damage, several times a
level-20 Bloodmage's bat; before the fix both report the same level-1 value.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the level-80 Bloodmage has a Shadow Bat
SETUP: the level-20 Bloodmage has a Shadow Bat
A level-20 bat hits harder than a level-1 one
A level-80 bat has level-80 weapon damage
Shadow Bat weapon damage scales with the owner's level
